name: manual_f0833f
claim: When a POSIX-only module is guarded on Windows and no WSL distribution exists, keep Mac or POSIX runtime qualification explicitly open.

decisions.notes: The private-authority core raises on non-POSIX hosts, and the Windows host had no WSL distribution; Windows tests could not establish POSIX qualification.

rationale: The private-authority core raises on non-POSIX hosts, and the Windows host had no WSL distribution; Windows tests could not establish POSIX qualification.
